## I'm submitting a... 

[ ] Regression (a behavior that used to work and stopped working in a new release)

[X ] Documentation issue or request
[ ] Support request => Please do not submit support request here, instead see https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#question
[X ] Other... Please describe: AIO css improvement request
## Current behavior Table style is adequate, but it could be improved. ## Expected behavior Some ideas for improvements: - Make table heading row font style more consistent with page subheading style - Reduce white space, so tables feel more sophisticated and can display a bit more info at once (without scrolling) ## Minimal reproduction of the problem with instructions Tables that come up in a search for "table" across docs. https://angular.io/guide/docs-style-guide#tables https://angular.io/guide/module-types https://angular.io/guide/ngmodule-api#ngmodule-metadata https://angular.io/guide/ajs-quick-reference https://angular.io/guide/router#router-events https://angular.io/guide/template-syntax#binding-targets Incorrectly use markdown tables (not HTML): https://angular.io/guide/i18n#setting-up-the-locale-of-your-app https://angular.io/guide/aot-compiler#folding (Open issue to fix them so they are HTML: https://github.com/angular/angular/issues/23978) ## What is the motivation / use case for changing the behavior? issue.body:
The approach for tables is more of an ad-hoc determination based on the
complexity of what's in them. If/when we enable formatting of markdown
files, that will also make the markdown format of tables easier to read
and more consistent.

fixes #23978
